evaluationRules: Use the canonical manual transcription as expected data; preserve source-line provenance.
Use original image SHA-256 and byte size to bind each expected record to its source screenshot.
Score field-level exact match only where fieldStatus.eligible_for_exact_match is true.
Score nine-field full-record exact match only for the 21 records with all nine eligible expected values.
Do not score missing, partial, illegible, or explicitly uncertain expected values.
For console reward pairs, preserve both base and WITH PREMIUM values; use the explicitly labeled WITH PREMIUM/final-received value as the canonical scalar, retaining base values in notes.

Do not treat field-level partial coverage as a Gate B pass. Gate B remains NOT_PASSED until at least 50 images have complete, independent nine-field expected values and all acceptance conditions pass.
